activity_single_parent_check.name: activity_single_parent_check
activity_single_parent_check.value: ("activity"."site_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("activity"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

assessments_override_reason_check.name: assessments_override_reason_check
assessments_override_reason_check.value: "assessments"."is_override" = false OR ("assessments"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "assessments"."overridden_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

assessments_size_range_check.name: assessments_size_range_check
assessments_size_range_check.value: ("assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_low" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_low" >= 0) AND ("assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_high" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_high" >= 0) AND ("assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_low" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_high" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_low" <= "assessments"."estimated_system_size_kw_high")

assessments_generation_range_check.name: assessments_generation_range_check
assessments_generation_range_check.value: ("assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_low" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_low" >= 0) AND ("assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_high" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_high" >= 0) AND ("assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_low" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_high" IS NULL OR "assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_low" <= "assessments"."estimated_annual_generation_kwh_high")

documents_single_parent_check.name: documents_single_parent_check
documents_single_parent_check.value: ("documents"."site_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("documents"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

investors_ticket_size_check.name: investors_ticket_size_check
investors_ticket_size_check.value: ("investors"."ticket_size_min" IS NULL OR "investors"."ticket_size_min" >= 0) AND ("investors"."ticket_size_max" IS NULL OR "investors"."ticket_size_max" >= 0) AND ("investors"."ticket_size_min" IS NULL OR "investors"."ticket_size_max" IS NULL OR "investors"."ticket_size_min" <= "investors"."ticket_size_max")

sites_complete_once_submitted_check.name: sites_complete_once_submitted_check
sites_complete_once_submitted_check.value: "sites"."submission_status" = 'draft' OR ("sites"."address_raw" IS NOT NULL AND "sites"."site_type" IS NOT NULL AND "sites"."ownership_status" IS NOT NULL)
